blind.description: A stylized arched wooden door leaf constructed of vertical planks held together by three heavy dark iron horizontal reinforcement straps studded with rivets. One edge has cylindrical hinge barrels, while the face features an iron ring pull handle and a rectangular keyhole escutcheon plate. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no floating, melted, or detached components. It rests upright directly on the floor without any added plinth or base.
blind.from_above: A rounded rectangular cross-section showing the ends of five vertical wooden planks framed by studded metal strap bands on the sides, with a cylindrical hinge pin extending to the left and a ring handle mount extending to the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 feet tall (roughly 80% of the figure's height) and about 2.5 feet wide.

notes: depth is thicker than realistic door leaf to accommodate hinges and ring pull
